title: FP5 register path (press OK)
intro: One press only. Water-drop = started. Ding + flash = PRESS ~1s. Shutter = LIFT. Then a quiet capture (may black the screen). We only need nz≠0 / frame raw. Black = hold Power.

steps.title: 1 — Quiet baseline
steps.instruction: Hands completely off the power-button sensor. We measure background IRQ rate.

steps.title: 2 — Press probe (3 taps)
steps.instruction: On TAP NOW press the power-button FP firmly ~1s, then LIFT fully.

steps.title: 3 — Register hold
steps.instruction: Get ready, then HOLD finger firmly for 5s (enroll-style).

steps.title: 4 — Register samples (6×)
steps.instruction: Six enroll-style samples: TAP ~1s, full LIFT, slight angle change if comfortable. This is the practice path toward a template.

steps.title: 5 — Quiet after
steps.instruction: Hands off again so we can compare rates.

outro: Session saved. If you see PRESS OK, optional «Try register» runs TrustZone enroll once (finger on power-button). Not automatic.
